Yesterday was a decent rest day, Chris. No training session logged, but your 7,312 steps kept you moving and your 2,504 kcal burn sat nicely above your 2,300 kcal target — a small deficit that's working in favour of that 80-85kg goal.

Your recovery picture is mixed. HRV at 85ms sits just below your 89-117ms baseline, which signals your body is slightly under-recovered. Sleep was the weak link at 6.8 hours — that's likely why HRV dipped. Tonight, aim for 7.5-8 hours. Hit your 175g protein today to support muscle repair, and you'll be in a stronger position tomorrow.
